elements.content:
Susan: Christmas is coming. What do you want for

Christmas this year?

Steven: I want a camera this year. What about you?

Susan: I want a book and a violin. I hope Santa will

bring them for me.

Steven: What are you going to give to your parents as

Christmas gifts?

Susan: I’ll give my mom a beautiful scarf.

Steven: You’re thoughtful. I plan to make handmade

cards and cookies for my family.

elements.content:

Good morning to you, good morning to you.

It’s a beautiful day, let’s go out and play.

Good afternoon to you, good afternoon to you.

child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
苏珊：圣诞节快到了。今年圣诞节你想 要什么礼物？

史蒂文：今年我想要一台照相机。你呢？

苏珊：我想要一本书和一把小提琴。我希

望圣诞老人会把它们带给我。

史蒂文：你打算给父母送什么圣诞礼物？

苏珊：我要给我妈妈一条漂亮的围巾。

史蒂文：你想得真周到。我打算为我的家

人手工制作卡片和饼干。

child_list.content: 你好，你好，你好
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
你好，你好，你好。嗨，嗨，嗨。

早上好，早上好。

美好的一天，我们出去玩吧。

下午好，下午好。

美好的一天，让我们吹口哨吧。

晚上好，晚上好。

美好的夜晚，让我们在月光下跳舞吧。
